items.english: It was in a dim faint light, and there, quiet as the light itself, three people had drawn close with their heads together, telling a long story. The story seemed to go on between them for very long, without ever breaking off. And in that story all seemed to be told, all the good and evil of the world, sorrow and suffering and anger and anguish, and joy, all of it. Yet those who spoke and those who listened only went on quietly and peacefully smiling, and they did not move at all. With heads inclined and eyes lowered, only a quiet fond remembrance and forgiveness seemed to enfold them there. And there too a deep, deep peace showed itself in all of them.
notes: Kept the three figures unidentified and the thing seen as a picture, not a vision or world. Kept repetitions flat: long, all, quiet, smiling.

items.english: All things of the world, life itself, would pass. And when it had passed, only on that day when it had passed would all, all things, turn to fond remembrance and forgiveness. And then they would stand forever before a rest like night.
notes: Left that day and rest like night unresolved, as in the Japanese. Used would to hold the gnomic summary in past tense.

items.english: The far picture lay dark and quiet in the bottom of her eyes. And through the bottom of her eyes, far into the future, with a lonely peace, that picture was to be seen. Young as she was, alone she gave a lonely secret sigh, and glancing at the littered table and at the faces of her husband and the child, she fell silent.
notes: Kept far, eyes, quiet and lonely in plain repetition so the distance stays a place, not a metaphor.

data.say: Drafted the phantom picture and its summary without naming or consoling, holding repetitions into the silent return to the table.
